results.evidence: Fourth pass (r11, 2026-09-30), new angles only. Still no two independent sources stating one Tupso Pass trailhead -> Goat Flats one-way figure, so no op on days[0].miles (7.3). Stated one-way figures from that trailhead remain one author each: WTA Goat Flats page 4.5; 2003 WTA report 4.75; Abegg 5; NEW: a 2017 WTA trip report (zoshyii) '~6 miles of overgrown trail' from the actual trailhead to Goat Flats (a fourth, different, approximate number). NEW segment-only sources (summing would be computing): Brisbine's 2026 Meadow Mountain report summarises the Tupso Pass approach as 8.6 mi of road, then 2.2 to Saddle Lake and 2.2 to Goat Flats, with a one-way total of 13.0 mi measured from the Canyon Creek bridge (different start, includes the road); a 2003-10-05 WTA report 'first 2 miles to Saddle Lake' then 'the next 2 1/2 miles to Goat Flats'; a 2003-08-30 WTA report 2 1/2 + 2 1/2; hike2hike 2 1/2 + 2; Backpacker's Boulder River Wilderness article, a 5.8-mi trail to Saddle Lake then 'Follow the trail 2.3 more miles' to Goat Flat (the USFS text, already counted). The Mountaineers route page (read via a Wayback copy, 2025-04-18) gives only 16.0 mi round trip and the washout adding ~16 mi RT, no Goat Flats figure. Brisbine's older Goat Flats report and his North Peak report give round-trip totals only (14 mi). Jeff Hebert's report gives only the ~10 mi road; komoot only the trip total; 2002/2008/2010/2019 WTA reports describe the road only. Google Books snippet search could not run (shared API quota exhausted); Green Trails map mileage tables are not published online. Day 2 (7.7 mi, note '~7.5 miles back out'): two reports put Goat Flats -> lookout at about 3 mi (2017 WTA '~3 miles up some steeper hills'; a 2021 blog '3 miles out'), but day 2 is Goat Flats -> lookout -> back -> trailhead, so any day-2 figure would be computed; no source states one. No op. Owner option unchanged: adopt WTA's 4.5 for days[0].miles and the totalNote (the row's own approach text already says Goat Flats ~4.5 mi total), and decide day 2 on the owner's read.

Fourth pass (r11, 2026-09-30), new angles only. Still no published one-way Foggy Dew trailhead -> Cooney Lake figure on the row's line (#417 up the North Fork through Merchants Basin, then the Cooney Lake trail), so no op on days[0].miles (6.2).
